categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: (1) Adsorption functional materials, including magnetic rubber materials and consumer products used in advertising displays, office education, home decoration, and toys; (2) Electronic ceramic components, including ring varistors, chip varistors, and NTC thermistors used in micromotor protection and surge protection; (3) Other functional materials, including high-energy ray radiation shielding materials and MIM products (metal injection molding) with high-density alloys.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in micro-nano powder material preparation, functional composite material processing, electronic ceramic component manufacturing, and equipment automation. The company employs self-designed automated production lines and has developed proprietary manufacturing processes for flexible magnetic materials, ceramic elements, and radiation shielding composites. Production follows a make-to-order model based on customer specifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse customer types across multiple industries including advertising and display, office equipment manufacturers, automotive suppliers, medical device manufacturers, home appliance producers, and telecommunications equipment makers. Primary end markets include advertising displays, office education, home decoration, automotive electronics, medical devices, and radiation protection applications in healthcare and nuclear industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with direct customers in over 60 countries and regions. Major markets include Europe, North America, East Asia (particularly Japan and South Korea), Southeast Asia, and China. The company maintains overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Vietnam, and the United States, and has established sales offices across multiple regions to support international business development.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures finished functional materials and components from raw materials and sells directly to industrial manufacturers and distributors. The company controls the complete production process from material preparation through final product manufacturing, positioning it as an integrated materials manufacturer rather than a raw material supplier or end-product consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven high-quality development and specializes in advanced materials. Key R&D initiatives include: developing thin, wide-format flexible magnetic materials; advancing rare-earth permanent magnet materials (samarium-iron-nitrogen); expanding radiation shielding material product lines including transparent radiation-protective materials; optimizing electronic ceramic component performance; and developing MIM technology for precision metal components. The company invested 48.5 million yuan in R&D in 2023, representing 6.29% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products to industrial customers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, which occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance for domestic sales, or upon customs clearance and departure for export sales. The company operates on a buy-and-sell model without involvement in downstream customer operations, maintaining direct relationships with approximately 650 overseas customers and numerous domestic clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In adsorption functional materials, the company holds the leading global market share position. In electronic ceramic components, particularly ring varistors, the company is among the world's leading suppliers with advanced process technology and comprehensive product categories. In radiation shielding materials, the company competes against international players like Germany's MAVIG, US Bar-Ray, and UK Kemmetech, positioning itself as a domestic leader in lead-free radiation protection materials. The company has been recognized as a 'Little Giant' specialized and innovative enterprise and holds national intellectual property demonstration enterprise status.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2023, the company reported total assets of 2.18 billion yuan and net assets of 1.99 billion yuan. 2023 revenue reached 771.2 million yuan, representing 7.88% growth compared to 2022's 714.9 million yuan. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 138.1 million yuan in 2023, up 7.96% year-over-year. The company completed its initial public offering in June 2023, issuing 26.23 million shares at 39.06 yuan per share, raising 945.2 million yuan in net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product performance, environmental sustainability, and technological innovation. Key value propositions include: ultra-wide and ultra-thin magnetic materials enabling direct printing and rapid replacement; comprehensive ring varistor product lines meeting diverse customer specifications; lead-free radiation shielding materials that are lighter, safer, and environmentally superior to traditional lead-based alternatives; and proprietary manufacturing processes enabling high precision and automation. The company emphasizes green manufacturing, having achieved carbon footprint certification and pursuing zero-carbon factory development.
